summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. Shareholders of record as of August 13, 2026 will vote on adopting amended articles, increasing authorized share capital, and a 1-for-150 reverse share split effective December 4, 2026. The filing is a routine notice of meeting and proxy materials distribution, not a special situation. No takeover, strategic review, or capital return event is involved. The reverse split is a structural corporate action but is not an extraordinary special situation category. Watch for shareholder approval and implementation of the split.
